scriptLines: query: 'SELECT c.d AS fecha_completa, YEAR(c.d) AS anio, DATEPART(QUARTER, c.d) AS trimestre, MONTH(c.d) AS mes, DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, c.d) AS semana_anio, DAY(c.d) AS dia_mes, ((DATEDIFF(DAY, DATEFROMPARTS(1900,1,1), c.d) % 7) + 1) AS dia_semana FROM (SELECT DATEADD(DAY, t.n, r.ini) AS d FROM (SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(MIN(u.d)), 1, 1) AS ini, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(MAX(u.d)), 12, 31) AS fin FROM (SELECT admission_date AS d FROM silver.admissions UNION ALL SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions UNION ALL SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing) u) r CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP (DATEDIFF(DAY, r.ini, r.fin) + 1) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS n FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b) t) c',

mes_nombre = case(mes==1,'Enero', mes==2,'Febrero', mes==3,'Marzo', mes==4,'Abril', mes==5,'Mayo', mes==6,'Junio', mes==7,'Julio', mes==8,'Agosto', mes==9,'Septiembre', mes==10,'Octubre', mes==11,'Noviembre', 'Diciembre'),
mes_corto = case(mes==1,'Ene', mes==2,'Feb', mes==3,'Mar', mes==4,'Abr', mes==5,'May', mes==6,'Jun', mes==7,'Jul', mes==8,'Ago', mes==9,'Sep', mes==10,'Oct', mes==11,'Nov', 'Dic'),
dia_nombre = case(dia_semana==1,'Lunes', dia_semana==2,'Martes', dia_semana==3,'Miércoles', dia_semana==4,'Jueves', dia_semana==5,'Viernes', dia_semana==6,'Sábado', 'Domingo'),
